limits: The source has 203 literal slots. The original printed 25-coordinate strikeout is retained, leaving the same 178-slot frame and unchanged Oct4–6 key.
The source glyphs at indices 136 and 185 remain D and invalid U. This is a separately priced language-based proposal, not a source transcription correction.
The ordinary article DES explains the sequence OHNE BETEILIGUNG DES K.M. without adding or deleting a plaintext position. K.M. remains literal and no institutional identification is supplied.

All 216 combinations of the first label and the six allowed second-label values are retained with exact costs. Sixty alternatives share the proposed one-additional-substitution cost; grammar selects DES conditionally, not cryptographic uniqueness.

The native fixed count under the printed-strikeout frame remains 88/89. The earlier word repair costs one observed substitution; the full conditional layer costs two observed substitutions and one invalid-glyph fill.
All dates, NATEKS, reference 8557 and the source frame are retained. No new physical record is added.
credit: Childs source and published Oct4–6 key; the existing October Caucasus source edition and its attribution are preserved. Conditional grammatical completion and exact coordinate pricing: icekylinx and GPT-6 Astra Pro. No first historical decipherment claim.
